title: Analysis Intake Department
purpose: Create a governed intake layer that converts structured JSON or raw human notes into classified governed work items.
mission: Transform human-supplied ideas, notes, audits, transcripts, and JSON packets into routed governance artifacts.
raw_text_rules: Raw text SHALL be treated as provisional input, not authority.
The intake agent SHALL extract candidate claims, terms, operators, risks, and work items.
The intake agent SHALL not promote claims directly from raw text.
Every extracted item SHALL preserve source excerpt and source path.
Ambiguous items SHALL be routed to review rather than forced into a registry.
json_rules: Structured JSON SHALL be schema-validated before routing.
Valid JSON packets MAY produce direct proposed registry patches.
Invalid or partial JSON SHALL be routed as raw intake with parse warnings.

governance_rules.text: Analysis Intake SHALL accept both structured JSON and raw human notes.
Raw input SHALL be classified into proposed governed work but SHALL NOT itself become authority.
Every routed item SHALL retain source provenance.
The intake department SHALL recommend routing but SHALL NOT execute, promote, or close work.
